title: Walter Van Beirendonck

info: Walter Van Beirendonck(1957년 2월 4일생)은 벨기에의 패션 디자이너다. 2022년까지 앤트워프 왕립예술아카데미 패션학과장을 지냈다. Walter Van Beirendonck (born 4 February 1957) is a Belgian fashion designer. He was the head of the fashion department at the Royal Academy of Fine Arts Antwerp until 2022.
